headline: Jash Engineering bags Rs 82 crore in consolidated orders for October
hook: New export orders beat domestic wins
summary: Jash Engineering reported consolidated order inflows of Rs 82 crore for October 2026. Of the total order value, Rs 40 crore came from the domestic market, while international markets contributed Rs 42 crore. These order updates put Jash Engineering, along with peers Ashoka Buildcon and Texmaco Rail, in focus for retail investors. The order flow indicates steady project wins across both domestic and overseas segments for the engineering firm.
why_it_matters: Order inflows signal steady revenue visibility for the company.
winners_losers: Jash Engineering gains / peers in focus
